question:
Every tool in a workshop makes something easier, but not every tool makes you better at the job. Choose a tool and find out which kind it is.

Steps:
1. Start recording. Pick one tool from the list below.
2. Say one way it makes the job easier.
3. Say a different way it can make your work better, not just faster.
4. Say a time when using it too much could hurt you, and why.

Tool list:
- A calculator
- Spell check
- A map app
- A power drill
- A recipe

rubric.description: Student does not name a tool or say anything about it on camera.

Student attempts the task but does not meet Level 2. For example, the student gives a way the tool makes things easier but no different way it makes the work better, or gives only a way it could hurt.
Student gives a way the tool makes things easier AND a different way it makes the work better (not just faster).
Meets all of the above AND gives a time when using the tool too much could hurt, with a specific reason.
